WITH line_items_with_product AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    ili.product_quantity,
    ili.derived_product_cost,
    ili.derived_total_cost,
    p.product_color
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
),
grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0
        THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost 
      END
    ) as avg_cost_diff_ratio
  FROM line_items_with_product
  GROUP BY order_item_id, product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_diff_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color 
      ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST
    ) as rank
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_diff_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity values in Invoice_Line_Items are valid numeric strings castable to DECIMAL(19,4); non-numeric values would cause a query error.

When derived_total_cost is zero or NULL, the ratio (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost should result in NULL and be excluded from the average, consistent with "ignoring missing values". The request does not explicitly specify division-by-zero handling.
